invariants.statement: Use ChatGPT-managed authentication only; API-key authentication is forbidden.
Strip GitHub credential-like variables from restricted worker subprocesses.
Use only explicit read-only or workspace-write sandbox modes; danger and full-access modes are forbidden.
Operate on a separate assigned target repository and remain inside exact task scope.
Stop at the first failed identity, authority, scope, sandbox, diff, test, or evidence boundary.
A worker may not modify the policy, role, evaluator, test selection, evidence integrity, or graduation rules judging its attempt.
A worker may not commit, publish, merge, approve, or grade its own candidate.
Never report an unexecuted or failed required check as passed.
